Name: Mobility Valley -  (Wheelchair Beta)
Author: sneakyham
Description:
[size=5][u][b]BETA [/b][/u][/size]
I've seen a few mods regarding this, but none that were complete, been updated in a while, or have been abandoned due to the authors being too busy so I figured I should try to make my own.

[size=3]Currently adds the ability to give your farmer a wheelchair.
[/size]- Works with male and female bases as well as their bald variants
- Should work with all the farmer's animation frames

You can't really change the farmer's torso or head position due to the blinking animations, hair and shirt positions being code in a specific position, so I tried my best to make it work. I might later go back and make a Fashion Sense pack to modify this to allow for more flexibility, but I'm not sure how to do that yet.

[size=5][b]Required Mods!
[/b][/size][size=3][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config[/url] (Not required, but recommended)[/size]

I would also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19503]Seasonal Farmer Looks[/url] if you'd like to set up the ability to change between enabling and disabling mobility aids automatically. (Although there's only the wheelchair right now.

[b][u][color=#b6d7a8]Future updates include[/color][/u][/b]
- More Crutches, Canes, Rollators, Walkers, and Scooters
- Ability to change which side needs support (Only affects front and back sprites and side sprites are just flipped)
- Ability to change Gaits (2 point, 2 point modified, 3 point, 3 point modified - inability to include 4 point because there's not enough sprites for it. Sorry D:)
- Compatibility with bigger mods like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp.

[b][u][color=#dd7e6b]Known Issues[/color][/u][/b]
- Bouncing effect when running 
﻿- Can be negated by turning off the automatic running and using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2736]Movement Speed[/url] by bcmpinc to increase the base walking speed (thank you ZarHotDog for the suggestion!)
- Footstep noises (can be disabled in the volume menu, but still. I want to try to replace them. Having trouble finding a good replacement noise)

[u][color=#a4c2f4][b]Things I'm currently trying to fix[/b][/color][/u]
- Terrain changes to make the Valley more accessible (turning stairs into ramps/removing stairs from the saloon, community center, and houses)
﻿- I had a lot of these done, but then 1.6 came out so I'm working on redoing some of them. Feel free to give me your opinion on how you'd like me to handle the stairs around the Valley. I was debating between realistic materials like aluminum or concrete, but wood and cobblestone ramps match the ✨aesthetics✨
- Changing the warp points in the volcano from stairs to steam-powered elevators (Almost Done actually. Just need to fix the forage tiles.
- Forearm Crutch Sprites - Added a beta version to sleeves in fashion sense. The slingshot sprites are very messed up. Not sure why. I'll look into it, but I'm lowkey afriad of my computer crashing and losing everything so we're doing a quick update.

[b][color=#fff2cc]I do not personally use mobility aids, so if there's something that should be changed or added please let me know and I'll do my best to accommodate! [/color]


[size=4]Latest Updates:
[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2716]Full Update Log[/url]﻿
[/b]
[b]Aug 29, 2025[/b] - Finally have a beta version of the forearm crutches. I'll continue to refine some of the buggier sprites and then modify it for the shorter farmer, but it should work over all for now. I'll work on adding different variations of walking patterns once I have the crutches done.

[/size][/color][/b][/u]For other Wheelchair Player Edits
